operation.description:
Lists all GitHub-hosted runners configured in an organization.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `manage_runner:org` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: List GitHub-hosted runners for an organization

#/components/parameters/org.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/org.name: org

#/components/parameters/page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/page.name: page

#/components/parameters/per-page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/per-page.name: per_page

id.description: The unique identifier of the hosted runner.

image_gen.description: Whether custom image generation is enabled for the hosted runners.

last_active_on.description: The time at which the runner was last used, in ISO 8601 format.

maximum_runners.description: The maximum amount of hosted runners. Runners will not scale automatically above this number. Use this setting to limit your cost.

name.description: The name of the hosted runner.

platform.description: The operating system of the image.

public_ip_enabled.description: Whether public IP is enabled for the hosted runners.

public_ips.description: The public IP ranges when public IP is enabled for the hosted runners.

runner_group_id.description: The unique identifier of the group that the hosted runner belongs to.

#/components/schemas/actions-hosted-runn.description: Provides details of a particular machine spec.

id.description: The ID used for the `size` parameter when creating a new runner.

memory_gb.description: The available RAM for the machine spec.

storage_gb.description: The available SSD storage for the machine spec.

#/components/schemas/actions-hosted-runn.title: Github-owned VM details.

#/components/schemas/nullable-actions-ho.description: Provides details of a hosted runner image

id.description: The ID of the image. Use this ID for the `image` parameter when creating a new larger runner.

version.description: The image version of the hosted runner pool.

#/components/schemas/nullable-actions-ho.title: GitHub-hosted runner image details.

#/components/schemas/public-ip.description: Provides details of Public IP for a GitHub-hosted larger runners

length.description: The length of the IP prefix.

prefix.description: The prefix for the public IP.

#/components/schemas/public-ip.title: Public IP for a GitHub-hosted larger runners.
